title: How Finishing the Boring Part Builds a Godly Man's Work Ethic
caption:
God isn't grading your resume.

He's grading the part of the job nobody sees you finish.

The last five percent of a task is unglamorous. Skipping it doesn't get noticed today. It gets noticed for the rest of your life.

Colossians 3:23 doesn't say work hard for the parts that make the report. Work like the report isn't the point.

Ninety percent feels like done. It isn't. The last stretch is where character gets built, not talent.

You'll do a hundred things this year nobody claps for. That's not wasted work. That's the work that's actually forming you.
